annotations.body: I'd like to rewrite this core architecture thing as a one-dimensional system: the GameCube decomp harness. The core architecture is a shared knowledge base, and various agent types write to it, process it with their toolbox, and then write into the knowledge base of the different workers.  I'm trying to make this a high-level architecture of how the system works: we spawn massive amounts of workers that write into the shared knowledge base, and that's how it creates this swarm effect.

replies.body: I rewrote the page around the GameCube decomp harness as a shared-knowledge swarm: bounded agent types read common evidence, act through role-specific toolboxes, and publish results for later workers. I also reframed scheduling and dispatch as coordination around that loop. The system-flow canvas still needs the canvas editor because its editing handoff is unavailable in this session, so I left the existing canvas unchanged rather than approximating it with prose.
